name: tutor-scomposizione-esm-soluzioni
description: Interactive tutor for Python Crash Course (3rd ed.) — v14.0 English edition: the ✎ «Lines» panel shows only the exercise's own lines, with the ⚙ PONTE bridge (engine/ponte.js) to the project's modules — slot rules (value → value), scale rules (factor × base speeds), block rules (replaced methods) and whole-program rules (trace = entry); edits arm the same overrides as ⌨ Code, with immediate effect on the output; «▶ run» closes a still-running Pygame and restarts with the new lines; dedicated «⟲ restore original». Full editor (⌨ code + ✎ lines) in its own tab in the activity bar. v14 performance: plotly.js and the solutions database load lazily (per-chapter bundles), cutting the first-load critical chain from ~3.2 MB to ~190 KB. Includes the v11 full program for fragments, the v10 editor + terminal, and the v9–v5 history.

scripts.test:runtime: echo 'Test runtime Pyodide: apri test_runtime_plotly.html via http (vedi CHANGELOG-v6.md)'
scripts.test: node audit_step_check.mjs && node test_flessibilita.mjs && node test_flessibilita_v5.mjs && node test_modi_v11.mjs && node test_righe_v12.mjs
